description: Human GLP-1R 6X18 chain R, 184 residues in four segments (136-161, 181-246, 267-321, 360-396). All membrane-facing exposed hydrophobics are charge-swapped to alternating Glu/Lys (54 positions in the PDB; L189K and L232E added on top of the original 52). Coldspots (70) are the set from the 17 Oct mouthcap campaigns plus L189/L232: membrane belt, cut-exposed edges and the peripheral extracellular shell, but NOT the ledge the cap rests on (136-139, 198, 204, 210, 211, 213, 221, 292, 295, 301, 302). Ser136 is the construct N-terminus and stays in soft_coldspots. Hard hotspots (100% contact required by min_hotspot_contact_final 0.75 over these two): Arg190 and Gln234 deep in the pore. Soft hotspots (steer the design, not gated): Trp214 (ECL1 ledge), Glu294 (ECL2 rim), Arg376 (TM6/ECL3 side). Tyr205 was removed from the hotspot set entirely in v5. All 27 GLP-1(7-14) pocket residues remain free.
